# Data Science Skills Analysis

## Approach

### Background and Information

This project is a combination of research with a main focus on exploratory data analysis on in-demand skills within data science jobs. With this project, research will be conducted on:

-   Data sources

-   Websites with jobs listings (i.e. Linkedin)

-   What skills are currently used

### The Question

Which data science skills are most valued?

### Data Source Acquisition

With this project I will scrape off a website to get the data I need, after research I have decided to scrape off of Glassdoor with job listings.

However, since there are restrictions with certain websites, I have decided to create a tibble to check various companies if I am allowed to scrape off of or not.

-   Scraped October 24th, 2026

<!-- -->

-   [Glassdoor](https://www.glassdoor.com/Job/data-scientist-jobs-SRCH_KO0,14.htm)

-   654 Job Postings

### Tools

-   [**Github:**]{.underline} Storing Data and Files

-   [**RStudio:**]{.underline} Where the code will be written in R using Quarto

-   [**RPubs:**]{.underline} To publish at the end of this project

### The Plan

In order to conduct an analysis on the data, we need to do the following:

-   Extract data from one job board with different companies

-   Load and then clean the dataset

-   See if the dataset requires further modifications to extract keywords for jobs

-   Conduct analysis such as plots and tables

## Codebase

### Install Packages

```{r install packages}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "rvest", "robotstxt", "jsonlite", "rlang", "httr2", "usethis"))
```

### Import Libraries

```{r import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(robotstxt)
library(jsonlite)
library(httr2)
library(usethis)
```

### Extracting the Data

```{r checking one company, include=FALSE}
slug <- "airbnb"   # any company that uses Greenhouse

resp <- request(paste0("https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/", slug, "/jobs")) |>
  req_url_query(content = "true") |>
  req_perform()

dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(resp_body_string(resp), paste0("data/raw/", slug, "_", Sys.Date(), ".json"))

jobs <- resp_body_json(resp)$jobs
length(jobs)        # how many postings
names(jobs[[1]])    # what fields each posting has
```

```{r checking the contents of the data, include=FALSE}
postings <- tibble(
  id         = map_dbl(jobs, "id"),
  company    = map_chr(jobs, "company_name"),
  title      = map_chr(jobs, "title"),
  location   = map_chr(jobs, \(j) pluck(j, "location", "name", .default = NA_character_)),
  department = map_chr(jobs, \(j) pluck(j, "departments", 1, "name", .default = NA_character_)),
  published  = map_chr(jobs, \(j) pluck(j, "first_published", .default = NA_character_)),
  content    = map_chr(jobs, \(j) pluck(j, "content", .default = NA_character_))
)

glimpse(postings)
```

```{r filtering for data science related, include=FALSE}
ds_pattern <- regex(
  "data scien|data analy|data engineer|analytics|machine learning|\\bML\\b|\\bAI\\b|applied scien|research scien|statistic|business intelligence|\\bBI\\b",
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

ds_postings <- postings |>
  filter(str_detect(title, ds_pattern))

nrow(ds_postings)
ds_postings |> select(company, title) |> print(n = 50)
```

```{r getting data, include=FALSE}
collect_board <- function(slug) {
  resp <- request(paste0("https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/", slug, "/jobs")) |>
    req_url_query(content = "true") |>
    req_perform()

  writeLines(resp_body_string(resp), paste0("data/raw/", slug, "_", Sys.Date(), ".json"))
  jobs <- resp_body_json(resp)$jobs

  tibble(
    id         = map_dbl(jobs, "id"),
    company    = map_chr(jobs, "company_name"),
    title      = map_chr(jobs, "title"),
    location   = map_chr(jobs, \(j) pluck(j, "location", "name", .default = NA_character_)),
    department = map_chr(jobs, \(j) pluck(j, "departments", 1, "name", .default = NA_character_)),
    published  = map_chr(jobs, \(j) pluck(j, "first_published", .default = NA_character_)),
    content    = map_chr(jobs, \(j) pluck(j, "content", .default = NA_character_))
  )
}

slugs <- c("airbnb", "stripe", "databricks", "coinbase", "datadog",
           "instacart", "reddit", "lyft", "dropbox", "discord")
more <- c("anthropic", "pinterest", "robinhood", "doordash", "figma", "asana",
          "gitlab", "cloudflare", "mongodb", "twilio", "okta", "duolingo",
          "affirm", "etsy", "squarespace", "airtable")
slugs <- c(slugs, more)

results <- map(slugs, \(s) {
  Sys.sleep(1)  # be polite to the server
  tryCatch(collect_board(s), error = \(e) { message("Failed: ", s); NULL })
})

all_postings <- bind_rows(results)
ds_postings  <- all_postings |> filter(str_detect(title, ds_pattern))

count(all_postings, company)
count(ds_postings, company)
```

```{r writing csv, include=FALSE}
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(ds_postings, paste0("data/ds_postings_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"))
```

### Load in the Data

```{r loading in dataset}
data <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaiderrX/CUNY-SPS-MSDS/refs/heads/main/DATA607/Projects/Project_3/data/ds_postings_2026-10-24.csv")

head(data)
```

### Fix the HTML Part of the Column

```{r fix html column}
html_to_text <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  once <- read_html(paste0("<body>", x, "</body>")) |> html_text()  # &lt;p&gt; -> <p>
  read_html(paste0("<body>", once, "</body>")) |> html_text2()      # strip the tags
}

ds_postings <- ds_postings |>
  mutate(description = map_chr(content, html_to_text))

# the head
ds_postings |> select(company, title, location, department, published) |> head(10)

# one cleaned description, to check it reads like normal text
ds_postings$description[1] |> str_trunc(1500) |> cat()
```

```{r trim repeated message}
ds_postings <- ds_postings |>
  mutate(description_trimmed = str_remove(
    description,
    regex("(Our Commitment To Inclusion|Reasonable Accommodations|Equal Employment Opportunity).*$",
          dotall = TRUE)
  ))
```

```{r checking for duplicates or repeated titles}
ds_postings |> count(id) |> filter(n > 1)                      # same posting pulled twice?
ds_postings |> count(company, title) |> filter(n > 1)          # same title repeated
```
